title: TRICARE Prime Unused-Month Credit: Months Counted and Their Value
content:
**Credit clause.** On the last paid installment of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment that ended for a credit-eligible reason, the installment credited is the enrollment's installment charge whose coverage period begins latest; the credit counts the whole calendar months of it after the month containing the disenrollment date, credits each at one twelfth of the installment's charge (its charge divided by 12), rounded to the cent, and takes off the amount by which the payments against the installment fall short of its charge.

- Every month of the credited installment from the first counted month on counts, through the last month of its coverage period.
- The credit posted is the value of the counted months less what comes off, never below zero, rounded to the cent.
- Months are calendar months (12 to a plan year, in 4 calendar quarters), numbered continuously from January 2000.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

An annual installment of 390.12 covering January to December; disenrollment date 20 July.

| Payments against the installment | Months counted | Value of a month (390.12 divided by 12) | Value of the counted months | Shortfall that comes off | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 390.12 | August to December: 5 | 32.51 | 162.55 | 0.00 | 162.55 |
| 300.00 | 5 | 32.51 | 162.55 | 90.12 | 72.43 |
| 0.00 | 5 | 32.51 | 162.55 | 390.12 | 0.00 (never below zero) |

A disenrollment date of 31 December leaves no month after the disenrollment month inside this installment, and the credit is 0.00.
